# Social Media Community Rules

### The Vote.je social media channels promote the work of voting and standing for election to the States Assembly – Jersey’s elected parliament.

The Social Media Community Rules apply to all Vote.je channels, [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/voteje/), [X](https://twitter.com/Voteje), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/vote.je/), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/vote-je), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCgOeAhYE9au2L38xnu4AehA) and [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@votejersey)to ensure that our social media community is a safe, friendly and open space for all Islanders.

Social media users are requested to comply with the following guidelines and rules.

**We encourage Islanders to:**

- Share their views and relevant thoughts about the subject area / topic in the post
- Read these rules carefully and accept them before participating

**General guidelines**

- We appreciate that opinions differ, but we ask that you are considerate and polite when commenting
- Think before you post! Remember your comments are open for others to see, so be mindful of what you say. Ask yourself, would you say this in real life to a person?
- Be courteous and respectful when sharing your opinions, be aware of the words you choose

**Rules**

We do not tolerate any disrespectful discussion, specifically:

- Do not use any swear words in your comments
- Do not share comments that are unlawful, abusive, violent, sexual, racist, harassing, or indecent towards any individual or group
- Do not make discriminatory comments based on race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sexuality, sex, gender, age or disability
- Do not make defamatory comments or untrue statements that could damage the reputation of a States Member or Islander
- Do not make comments that are not relevant to the topics raised on the page such as the promotion of any services or pages
- Do not make comments that contain personal information without permission (names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses)
- Do not make or use profiles that are impersonating someone else or share comments from fake accounts
- Do not advertise any products and / or services
- Do not make or share content that is designed to mislead and is not factual

**Moderation**

The States Greffe team actively monitors the social media channels. If there are any comments that are in breach of these rules, the consequences and actions may include:

- Hiding and/or deleting your comment
- Reporting your comment to the social media platform officials for breaking community standards
- Blocking users temporarily and / or permanently from accessing the page
- Reporting you to the States of Jersey Police for investigation

These guidelines and rules are in place to protect all page users and ensure that all interactions are respectful.

If you would like further information on these rules and guidelines, please email [contact@vote.je](mailto:contact@vote.je)and we will aim to respond within 2-3 working days.

- [**Read the Social Media Policy on following accounts**\\
(PDF, 78 KB)](https://www.vote.je/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Social-Media-Guidance-on-followers-FINAL-2024.pdf)

#### Register for updates

Whether you're considering standing for election in 2026 or simply want to stay informed as a voter, sign up to receive the latest news and events direct to your inbox.

Your name and email address will be held securely by the States Greffe and used only for the purpose of sharing election updates.
